body:
Impossibility.
Previous to this experience, I have taken LSD, 2c-b/e/p, MDMA, MDA, DMT, mushrooms, ketamine, mxe, and DOC from this same batch.
The following is my experience with DOC, and Methoxetamine.
T+0 60mg mxe sublingual
Lightweight feeling, slight itchiness.
T+1.5h insufflated 20 mg mxe
Instantly higher
T+2.25 dropped 5 mg DOC sublingual
Totally numb from mxe
T+3 not much in between goes as fast as 10 minutes until DOC feelings kick in
T+4.5 DOC kicking in, warmness moving up spine
T+5 slight psychedelic look to things, feeling the amphetamine part of DOC, warmness in legs
T+5.5 DOC definitely in action. Severe distortions and beautiful closed eye imagery, with flowing shapes.
T+6 I have no comprehension of time. It seems meaningless to me.
Mxe seems to be keeping me more in a sober reality while DOC tends to bring me towards the psychedelic end.
Constant fluctuation between the two seems to be the trend.
T+6.5 10mg mxe insufflated   growing feelings of dissosiativeness? Sp
Everything looks oddly real yet not? Hard to describe almost like I'm seeing things in sober life. Followed by a burst of psychedelic visuals all over whatever I was looking at.
~T+8 Living in the moment seems to be how these chemicals react. Music is extraodinary
Capable of many thoughts going though my mind at once, machnine like? Music is enjoyable beyond belief
Slipping in and out of dissossiativeness. Interesting..
T+10 About now, the MXE has taken over in the body high and mental high, while the DOC is quite clearly still going, as the visual distortions are still quite strong. Euphoria still quite pronounced.
T+12 Definitely time for bed. Utterly drained.
This particular combination is definitely worth exploring, if you get the right balance. It became incredibly mindblowing while the peaks were matching up. I am still in awe of how spiritual it was. MXE could possibly synch up with LSD. Will have to test.
